Good to know

Quick
answers.

Are you open 24 hours?

Our listing shows open 24 hours. Home delivery runs 9:00 am – 9:30 pm. Call 099376 59410 to confirm for late nights.

Do you take reservations?

Yes. Use the form above or message us on WhatsApp to reserve a table or room.

How can I pay?

Credit and debit cards and Google Pay are accepted.

Is there parking?

Yes, free parking options are available, including on-site parking.

Is it good for families and kids?

Yes. We have a kids' menu, high chairs and a changing table, with vegetarian options for everyone.
